_note: CORRECTION 2026-08-11: The original statement 'Do NOT re-apply sRGB->linear conversion' was incorrect. In a Linear color-space project, Unity converts the RGB of Color properties without the [HDR] attribute from sRGB to Linear during GPU upload (alpha is not converted). Direct linear input is correct only for the three [HDR] properties (_Color_Shallow / _Color_Deep / _Specular_Color). Confirmed by measurements from actual Unity renders (predicted murky _SurfFoam_Color (0.515,0.336,0.112) vs measured (0.522,0.342,0.121)). See HDR_COLOR_KEYS / gammaColorToLinear in src/water/uniforms.ts for the port implementation. --- Original note follows --- Colors are stored EXACTLY as serialized in the Unity .mat files. Unity project uses LINEAR color space, so these RGBA values are linear-space floats (HDR colors keep intensity > 1, e.g. _Specular_Color). Do NOT re-apply sRGB->linear conversion. Alpha is used as opacity/blend factor by the shader. 'floats/vectors/colors/textures' contain only properties that exist in the live shader (UberStylizedWater.shader Properties block); everything else found in the .mat is preserved under 'legacy_unused' (leftovers from older shader versions - not sampled by the shipped shader). Texture wrap=repeat, filter=bilinear, mipmaps=on, sRGB=OFF (linear) for all water textures; 'Normal 2.png' is imported as a normal map. Keyword toggles: keywords list = enabled shader_feature keywords. Boolean floats _Enable_SurfaceFoam/_Enable_Intersection/_ConformToGeometry/_WorldSpaceDepth/_Invert_SurfFoam/_InterSec_Foam_Invert/_InterSec_GradientDissolve/_SL_EnableTrail/_ShoreFade are ToggleUI floats (0/1), not keywords.
